purpose: Clarify omitted funding cash on the exact saved 2022 diagnostic decisions; preserve original STOP and all seven gates
decision_source: Unchanged results/PREDICTIONS.json and SAMPLE_IDENTITIES.json; pred>0 threshold retained
quantity: Fixed coin units q=.12/Pentry per initial reference capital, short signed quantity=-q, held through the weekly probe. Pentry is original completed close, not slipped entry fill; original paid-short formula implies this quantity
cash_formula: short_receipt=q*sum(rate_fraction*charge_mark). Positive funding pays shorts; do not multiply interval-hours or compound/rebalance q
paired_formula: sum((selected_augmented-selected_baseline)*q*rate_fraction*mark)/50 calendar market weeks; identical selected probes cancel, including their missing marks
rate_units: Original raw last_funding_rate preserved without conversion; documentary decimal-fraction convention inferred from official API interestRate .0001 and official 0.01% interval convention. Per-event archive/API unit bridge unavailable due HTTP451. Report scale1 and alternative scale.01 separately; no certification claim
mark_data: Existing past_mark_price is strict prior completed minute close within60sec, not exact charge mark; missing marks never zero-filled
central_ownership: Existing descriptive event interval (D,D+7days]; excludes exact entry settlement and includes exact exit settlement only as declared proxy ordering
ownership_sensitivity: Events within +/-60sec of entry or exit may be owned or unowned; interior events held. Compute signed event-wise lower/upper enclosure; independent choices are conservative and need not be jointly attainable
mark_sensitivity: For all differential events with observed prior-minute proxy m, assume true charge mark in [m*(1-epsilon),m*(1+epsilon)] with fixed epsilon .01,.05,.20. These are assumptions, not empirically certified bounds
missing_mark_sensitivity: If differential event proxy is absent, assume charge mark in [.8*Pentry,1.2*Pentry] only for conditional sensitivity; central point must remain unavailable. Record exact missing identities
event_completeness: Verify raw event uniqueness, finite rate/positive interval, bracketing timestamps outside both ownership bands and nominal inter-event cadence <=60sec jitter; no rate/month selection or omitted bad events
summary: Whole2022 and two original halves; original price-cost calendar increment plus funding contribution/enclosure. Separate paired-identifiable quantity from unknown absolute arm cash
independent_check: Decimal hand-example with signed cash, changed settlement mark, fixed quantity, both boundary events, plus common-position missing-mark cancellation; numerical aggregate audit without fitting
network: Reuse existing 2.25MB source Git archive; one unauthenticated official funding-history probe failed HTTP451, preserve response and stop API attempts; no alternative domains/proxy/credentials
interpretation: No changed original pass/fail, no native wallet or original target relabeling. Negative fitted coefficient rejects the specified prior direction only; it does not refute all predictive value of funding input
